note: Responses from every /run_* endpoint before Phase 4b added meta. The step arrays recorded here must survive unchanged. The run_dijkstra rows are the exception: they were re-recorded after its two bugs were fixed, so they carry the corrected output and are marked with rebaselined.
order_sensitive_note: run_dijkstra used to pick the next node with min() over a set, so a tie was broken by set iteration order and the result varied between processes. It now walks the nodes in input order, so ties resolve the same way every run and no response in this file is order sensitive.
